question: Does senpai/submit-official.sh accept a committed in-branch mtp-head/ tree?
verdict: NO. The guard itself accepts it. `yukon submit`, which the guard execs, refuses it on a hard client-side 25 MiB compressed-archive cap. In-branch shipping of a full-size head is structurally impossible.

validate-assignment-scope.sh.note: usage error: requires BASE_SHA plus explicit SUBMITTED_PATH arguments; no candidate path is changed yet at R-0

verify-ranked-score-boundary.sh.message: ranked numerator is pinned baseline; candidate edits affect the MTP denominator only

q1_guard_requires_mtp_head_to_exist.detail: senpai/submit-official.sh builds protected_paths from .editablePaths[] and only ever passes them as git PATHSPECS to `git diff`, `git ls-files -v` and `git status --porcelain`. None of those commands error on a pathspec that matches nothing. path_is_editable() is used only to CLASSIFY changed paths, never to require them. benchmark.json.optionalEditablePaths lists mtp-head.manifest.json and mtp-head, and .github/scripts/overlay-editable-paths.sh skips a missing OPTIONAL path instead of failing closed.

q2_committed_428mb_tree_passes_dirty_pat.answer: Yes, provided it is COMMITTED. Untracked weights fail.
q2_committed_428mb_tree_passes_dirty_pat.detail: Rehearsed with a committed 8 MiB random binary at mtp-head/model.safetensors: gate 1 (git ls-files -v, 156 entries, no S/lowercase tag) PASS, gate 2 (git status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=all --ignored=matching) PASS clean. With the real 427,742,600 B head present but UNTRACKED, gate 2 FAILS with '?? mtp-head/model.safetensors'. .gitignore carries no mtp-head or *.safetensors rule, so head weights left in the working tree are reported as untracked and rejected.

q3_archive_or_diff_step_breaks.mechanism: createSubmissionArchive() (yukon.js:24343) runs node-tar with {gzip:true, portable:true, noMtime:true} over manifest.editablePaths from the WORKING TREE, then submitEditablePaths() reads the whole archive into memory and throws when archiveBytes.byteLength > SUBMISSION_ARCHIVE_MAX_BYTES.

largest_in_branch_head_that_fits.marked: extrapolated from the measured 0.861672 gzip ratio and the measured 487,121 B source-only archive

q3_archive_or_diff_step_breaks.why_2gib_cap_never_binds: The 2 GiB mtp-head cap in benchmark.json.editableSurfaceByteBudget.exemptPathMaxBytes and QwenMTPHeadDeclaration.defaultMaxBytes governs the head AFTER the runner resolves it. For source=remote the runner curls the artifact directly from HuggingFace, so it never traverses the archive. For source=in_branch the workflow reads $MLXFAST_JOB_WS/<path>, and MLXFAST_JOB_WS is the UNPACKED SUBMISSION ARCHIVE overlaid on the trusted checkout. The 25 MiB archive cap therefore binds ~82x tighter than the 2 GiB cap on the in_branch path only.

q4_budget_script_exempts_mtp_head.detail: check-editable-budget.sh:123-131 is_exempt() matches a path equal to, or prefixed by, each entry of .editableSurfaceByteBudget.exemptPaths. account_working_file() routes an exempt path into working_exempt_total, checks it against exemptPathMaxBytes, and RETURNS before the per-file and source-total checks. mtp-head/ bytes therefore never touch the 3,000,000 B source total. Measured on this base: source=2625537/3000000, exempt=2410/2147483648. Note mtp-head.manifest.json is NOT exempt (it matches neither 'mtp-head' exactly nor 'mtp-head/*') and correctly counts against source.

digest_convention_confirmed.rule: sha256 over the concatenation of '<file sha256>  <relpath>\n' lines, relpath relative to the head tree root, LC_ALL=C sorted, README.md excluded
digest_convention_confirmed.bytes_rule: sum of per-file `wc -c`, README.md excluded, computed per file to avoid the trailing 'total' line
digest_convention_confirmed.in_branch_extra_checks: path must be non-empty, not absolute, no '..', no backslash; must be a directory in the submission; must contain no symlinks

consequence: The head axis must ship through source=remote, exactly as the current manifest already does (hf:amal-david/qwen38-mtp-head-q2-q4-rerank-v1@ae6282749a52e052496dd5300b4aa441df7301e8) and exactly as both rival head submissions did. R-D must be respecified from an in_branch rehearsal to a remote-artifact publication. R-A, R-B, R-B2 and R-C are transport-independent and unaffected.
